segments.mn67:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā cātumāyaṃ viharati āmalakīvane.
segments.mn67:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena sāriputtamoggallānappamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni cātumaṃ anuppattāni honti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
segments.mn67:2.2: Te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.
segments.mn67:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn67:3.2: “ke panete, ānanda, uccāsaddā mahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope”ti?
segments.mn67:3.3: “Etāni, bhante, sāriputtamoggallānappamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni cātumaṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
segments.mn67:3.4: Te āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā”ti.
segments.mn67:4.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca –
segments.mn67:4.5: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.mn67:4.6: “kiṃ nu tumhe, bhikkhave, uccāsaddā mahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope”ti?
segments.mn67:4.7: “Imāni, bhante, sāriputtamoggallānappamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni cātumaṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
segments.mn67:4.8: Teme āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā”ti.
segments.mn67:5.1: “Gacchatha, bhikkhave, paṇāmemi vo, na vo mama santike vatthabban”ti.
segments.mn67:5.2: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya pakkamiṃsu.
segments.mn67:6.1: Tena kho pana samayena cātumeyyakā sakyā santhāgāre [sandhāgāre (ka.)] sannipatitā honti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
segments.mn67:6.2: Addasaṃsu kho cātumeyyakā sakyā te bhikkhū dūratova āgacchante;
segments.mn67:6.3: disvāna yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn67:6.6: “Tenahāyasmanto muhuttaṃ nisīdatha, appeva nāma mayaṃ sakkuṇeyyāma bhagavantaṃ pasādetun”ti.
segments.mn67:6.7: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū cātumeyyakānaṃ sakyānaṃ paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn67:7.1: Atha kho cātumeyyakā sakyā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho cātumeyyakā sakyā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn67:7.4: Seyyathāpi, bhante, bhagavatā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito, evameva bhagavā etarahi anuggaṇhātu bhikkhusaṅghaṃ.
segments.mn67:7.5: Santettha, bhante, bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ.
segments.mn67:7.6: Tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo.
segments.mn67:7.7: Seyyathāpi, bhante, bījānaṃ taruṇānaṃ udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ siyā vipariṇāmo;
segments.mn67:7.8: evameva kho, bhante, santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo.
segments.mn67:7.9: Seyyathāpi, bhante, vacchassa taruṇassa mātaraṃ apassantassa siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo;
segments.mn67:7.10: evameva kho, bhante, santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo.
segments.mn67:7.13: Seyyathāpi, bhante, bhagavatā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito; evameva bhagavā etarahi anuggaṇhātu bhikkhusaṅghan”ti.
segments.mn67:8.1: Atha kho brahmā sahampati bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya – seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ [sammiñjitaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva – brahmaloke antarahito bhagavato purato pāturahosi.
segments.mn67:8.2: Atha kho brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn67:9.3: Seyyathāpi, bhante, bhagavatā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito; evameva bhagavā etarahi anuggaṇhātu bhikkhusaṅghaṃ.
segments.mn67:9.4: Santettha, bhante, bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo.
segments.mn67:9.5: Seyyathāpi, bhante, bījānaṃ taruṇānaṃ udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo;
segments.mn67:9.6: evameva kho, bhante, santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya alabhantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo.
segments.mn67:9.7: Seyyathāpi bhante, vacchassa taruṇassa mātaraṃ apassantassa siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo;
segments.mn67:9.8: evameva kho, bhante, santettha bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ, tesaṃ bhagavantaṃ apassantānaṃ siyā aññathattaṃ, siyā vipariṇāmo.
segments.mn67:9.11: Seyyathāpi, bhante, bhagavatā pubbe bhikkhusaṅgho anuggahito; evameva bhagavā etarahi anuggaṇhātu bhikkhusaṅghan”ti.
segments.mn67:10.1: Asakkhiṃsu kho cātumeyyakā ca sakyā brahmā ca sahampati bhagavantaṃ pasādetuṃ bījūpamena ca taruṇūpamena ca.
segments.mn67:11.1: Atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.mn67:11.3: Pasādito bhagavā cātumeyyakehi ca sakyehi brahmunā ca sahampatinā bījūpamena ca taruṇūpamena cā”ti.
segments.mn67:12.1: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pattacīvaramādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.mn67:12.2: “kinti te, sāriputta, ahosi mayā bhikkhusaṅghe paṇāmite”ti?
segments.mn67:12.5: Appossukko dāni bhagavā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ anuyutto viharissati, mayampi dāni appossukkā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāramanuyuttā viharissāmā’”ti.
segments.mn67:12.6: “Āgamehi tvaṃ, sāriputta, āgamehi tvaṃ, sāriputta, diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāran”ti.
segments.mn67:13.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn67:13.2: “kinti te, moggallāna, ahosi mayā bhikkhusaṅghe paṇāmite”ti?
segments.mn67:13.5: Appossukko dāni bhagavā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ anuyutto viharissati, ahañca dāni āyasmā ca sāriputto bhikkhusaṅghaṃ pariharissāmā’”ti.
segments.mn67:13.7: Ahaṃ vā hi, moggallāna, bhikkhusaṅghaṃ parihareyyaṃ sāriputtamoggallānā vā”ti.
segments.mn67:14.4: Ūmibhayaṃ [ummībhayaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)], kumbhīlabhayaṃ, āvaṭṭabhayaṃ, susukābhayaṃ – imāni, bhikkhave, cattāri bhayāni udakorohante pāṭikaṅkhitabbāni.
segments.mn67:15.1: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, cattārimāni bhayāni idhekacce puggale imasmiṃ dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajite pāṭikaṅkhitabbāni.
segments.mn67:16.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn67:16.3: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto;
segments.mn67:16.4: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn67:16.5: Tamenaṃ tathā pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti, anusāsanti –
segments.mn67:16.6: ‘evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te ālokitabbaṃ, evaṃ te vilokitabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban’ti.
segments.mn67:16.8: ‘mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā aññe ovadāma, anusāsāma [ovadāmapi anusāsāmapi (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.mn67:16.9: Ime panamhākaṃ puttamattā maññe, nattamattā maññe, amhe [evaṃ (ka.)] ovaditabbaṃ anusāsitabbaṃ maññantī’ti.
segments.mn67:16.11: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ūmibhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
segments.mn67:17.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn67:17.3: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto;
segments.mn67:17.4: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn67:17.5: Tamenaṃ tathā pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ sabrahmacārī ovadanti anusāsanti –
segments.mn67:17.6: ‘idaṃ te khāditabbaṃ, idaṃ te na khāditabbaṃ; idaṃ te bhuñjitabbaṃ, idaṃ te na bhuñjitabbaṃ; idaṃ te sāyitabbaṃ, idaṃ te na sāyitabbaṃ; idaṃ te pātabbaṃ, idaṃ te na pātabbaṃ; kappiyaṃ te khāditabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na khāditabbaṃ; kappiyaṃ te bhuñjitabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na bhuñjitabbaṃ; kappiyaṃ te sāyitabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na sāyitabbaṃ; kappiyaṃ te pātabbaṃ, akappiyaṃ te na pātabbaṃ; kāle te khāditabbaṃ, vikāle te na khāditabbaṃ; kāle te bhuñjitabbaṃ, vikāle te na bhuñjitabbaṃ; kāle te sāyitabbaṃ, vikāle te na sāyitabbaṃ; kāle te pātabbaṃ, vikāle te na pātabban’ti.
segments.mn67:17.7: Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā yaṃ icchāma taṃ khādāma, yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ khādāma; yaṃ icchāma taṃ bhuñjāma, yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ bhuñjāma; yaṃ icchāma taṃ sāyāma, yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ sāyāma; yaṃ icchāma taṃ pivāma [pipāma (sī. pī.)], yaṃ na icchāma na taṃ pivāma;
segments.mn67:17.8: kappiyampi khādāma, akappiyampi khādāma; kappiyampi bhuñjāma, akappiyampi bhuñjāma; kappiyampi sāyāma, akappiyampi sāyāma; kappiyampi pivāma, akappiyampi pivāma; kālepi khādāma, vikālepi khādāma; kālepi bhuñjāma vikālepi bhuñjāma; kālepi sāyāma, vikālepi sāyāma; kālepi pivāma, vikālepi pivāma.
segments.mn67:17.9: Yampi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ denti tatthapime mukhāvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī’ti.
segments.mn67:17.11: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kumbhīlabhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
segments.mn67:18.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn67:18.3: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto;
segments.mn67:18.4: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn67:18.5: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.
segments.mn67:18.6: Arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi so tattha passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ [paricāriyamānaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)].
segments.mn67:18.8: ‘mayaṃ kho pubbe agāriyabhūtā samānā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricārimhā.
segments.mn67:18.9: Saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule [saṃvijjanti kho kule (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] bhogā.
segments.mn67:18.10: Sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātun’ti.
segments.mn67:18.12: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, āvaṭṭabhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
segments.mn67:19.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti –
segments.mn67:19.3: ‘otiṇṇomhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto;
segments.mn67:19.4: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā’ti.
segments.mn67:19.5: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.
segments.mn67:19.6: Arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā.
segments.mn67:19.7: Tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
segments.mn67:19.8: So rāgānuddhaṃsena [anuddhastena (sī. pī.)] cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
segments.mn67:19.9: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, susukābhayassa bhīto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto.
segments.mn67:20.1: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri bhayāni, idhekacce puggale imasmiṃ dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajite pāṭikaṅkhitabbānī”ti.
segments.mn67:20.3: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Pañcamattāni bhikkhusatānīti adhunā pabbajitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pañca satāni.
“ime kulaputtā dasabalaṃ adisvāva pabbajitā, etesaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassessāma, bhagavato santike dhammaṃ sutvā attano attano yathāupanissayena patiṭṭhahissantī”ti.
Senāsanāni paññāpayamānāti attano attano ācariyupajjhāyānaṃ vasanaṭṭhānāni pucchitvā dvāravātapānāni vivaritvā mañcapīṭhakaṭasārakādīni nīharitvā papphoṭetvā yathāṭṭhāne saṇṭhāpayamānā.
Pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānāti, bhante, idaṃ me pattaṃ ṭhapetha, idaṃ cīvaraṃ, idaṃ thālakaṃ, idaṃ udakatumbaṃ, imaṃ kattarayaṭṭhinti evaṃ samaṇaparikkhāre saṅgopayamānā.
Uccāsaddā mahāsaddāti uddhaṃ uggatattā uccaṃ, patthaṭattā mahantaṃ avinibbhogasaddaṃ karontā.
Kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilopeti kevaṭṭānaṃ macchapacchiṭhapitaṭṭhāne mahājano sannipatitvā –
“idha aññaṃ ekaṃ macchaṃ dehi, ekaṃ macchaphālaṃ dehi, etassa te mahā dinno, mayhaṃ khuddako”ti evaṃ uccāsaddaṃ mahāsaddaṃ karonti.
Macchagahaṇatthaṃ jāle pakkhittepi tasmiṃ ṭhāne kevaṭṭā ceva aññe ca “paviṭṭho na paviṭṭho, gahito na gahito”ti mahāsaddaṃ karonti.

Na vo mama santike vatthabbanti tumhe mādisassa buddhassa vasanaṭṭhānaṃ āgantvā evaṃ mahāsaddaṃ karotha, attano dhammatāya vasantā kiṃ nāma sāruppaṃ karissatha, tumhādisānaṃ mama santike vasanakiccaṃ natthīti dīpeti.
Tesu ekabhikkhupi “bhagavā tumhe mahāsaddamattakena amhe paṇāmethā”ti vā aññaṃ vā kiñci vattuṃ nāsakkhi, sabbe bhagavato vacanaṃ sampaṭicchantā “evaṃ, bhante,”ti vatvā nikkhamiṃsu.
Evaṃ pana tesaṃ ahosi “mayaṃ satthāraṃ passissāma, dhammakathaṃ sossāma, satthu santike vasissāmāti āgatā.

Evarūpassa pana garuno satthu santikaṃ āgantvā mahāsaddaṃ karimhā, amhākameva dosoyaṃ, paṇāmitamhā, na no laddhaṃ bhagavato santike vatthuṃ, na suvaṇṇavaṇṇasarīraṃ oloketuṃ, na madhurassarena dhammaṃ sotun”ti.
Tenupasaṅkamiṃsūti te kira sakyā āgamanasamayepi te bhikkhū tattheva nisinnā passiṃsu.
“kiṃ nu kho ete bhikkhū pavisitvāva paṭinivattā, jānissāma taṃ kāraṇan”ti cintetvā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
Kahaṃ pana tumheti tumhe idāneva āgantvā kahaṃ gacchatha, kiṃ tumhākaṃ koci upaddavo, udāhu dasabalassāti?

“āvuso, mayaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya āgatā, diṭṭho no bhagavā, idāni attano vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gacchāmā”ti kiñcāpi evaṃ vacanaparihāro atthi, evarūpaṃ pana lesakappaṃ akatvā yathābhūtameva ārocetvā bhagavatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhusaṅgho paṇāmitoti āhaṃsu.
Te pana rājāno sāsane dhuravahā, tasmā cintesuṃ –
“dvīhi aggasāvakehi saddhiṃ pañcasu bhikkhusatesu gacchantesu bhagavato pādamūlaṃ vigacchissati, imesaṃ nivattanākāraṃ karissāmā”ti.
Tesupi bhikkhūsu “mayaṃ mahāsaddamattakena paṇāmitā, na mayaṃ jīvituṃ asakkontā pabbajitā”ti ekabhikkhupi paṭippharito nāma nāhosi, sabbe pana samakaṃyeva,“evamāvuso,”ti sampaṭicchiṃsu.
Abhivadatūti etu bhikkhusaṅghoti evaṃ cittaṃ uppādento abhivadatu.
Aññathattanti dasabalassa dassanaṃ na labhāmāti pasādaññathattaṃ bhaveyya.
Siyā aññathattanti udakavārakāle udakaṃ alabhantānaṃ milātabhāvena aññathattaṃ bhaveyya, sussitvā milātabhāvaṃ āpajjanena vipariṇāmo bhaveyya.
Vacchakassa pana khīrapipāsāya sussanaṃ aññathattaṃ nāma, sussitvā kālakiriyā vipariṇāmo nāma.
Pasādito bhagavāti thero kira tattha nisinnova dibbacakkhunā brahmānaṃ āgataṃ addasa, dibbāya sotadhātuyā ca āyācanasaddaṃ suṇi, cetopariyañāṇena bhagavato pasannabhāvaṃ aññāsi.
“kañci bhikkhuṃ pesetvā pakkosiyamānānaṃ gamanaṃ nāma na phāsukaṃ, yāva satthā na peseti, tāvadeva gamissāmā”ti maññamāno evamāha.
Diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāranti phalasamāpattivihāraṃ anuyutto maññe bhagavā viharitukāmo, so idāni yathāruciyā viharissatīti evaṃ me ahosīti vadati.
Mayampi dānīti mayaṃ paraṃ ovadamānā vihārato nikkaḍḍhitā, kiṃ amhākaṃ parovādena.
Thero imasmiṃ ṭhāne viraddho attano bhārabhāvaṃ na aññāsi.
Ayañhi bhikkhusaṅgho dvinnampi mahātherānaṃ bhāro, tena naṃ paṭisedhento bhagavā āgamehītiādimāha.
Yo tāni abhīto hoti, so imasmiṃ sāsane patiṭṭhātuṃ sakkoti.
Itaro pana na sakkotīti dassetuṃ imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
Kodhupāyāsassetaṃ adhivacananti yathā hi bāhiraṃ udakaṃ otiṇṇo ūmīsu osīditvā marati, evaṃ imasmiṃ sāsane kodhupāyāse osīditvā vibbhamati.
Odarikattassetaṃ adhivacananti yathā hi bāhiraṃ udakaṃ otiṇṇo kumbhīlena khādito marati, evaṃ imasmiṃ sāsane odarikattena khādito vibbhamati.
Pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacananti yathā hi bāhiraṃ udakaṃ otiṇṇo āvaṭṭe nimujjitvā marati, evaṃ imasmiṃ sāsane pabbajito pañcakāmaguṇāvaṭṭe nimujjitvā vibbhamati.
Mātugāmassetaṃ adhivacananti yathā hi bāhiraṃ udakaṃ otiṇṇo caṇḍamacchaṃ āgamma laddhappahāro marati, evaṃ imasmiṃ sāsane mātugāmaṃ āgamma uppannakāmarāgo vibbhamati.
Vacīghosopi hi bahūhi ekaccaṃ pavattito ṭhānato ca dūrataro kevalaṃ mahānigghoso eva hutvā sotapathamāgacchati.
Macchavilopeti macche vilumpitvā viya gahaṇe, macchānaṃ vā nayane.
Vavassaggattheti nicchayatthe, idaṃ tāva amhehi vuccamānavacanaṃ ekantasotabbaṃ, pacchā tumhehi kātabbaṃ karothāti adhippāyo.
Paṭippharitoti na bhagavato sammukhāva, sakyarājūnaṃ puratopi vippharitova hoti.
Kāraṇūpacārena sassesu bījapariyāyoti āha “bījānaṃ taruṇānanti taruṇasassānan”ti.
Kattabbassa saraseneva karaṇaṃ cittaruciyaṃ, na tathā parassa ussādanenāti āha –
Mayampi bhagavā viya diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāreneva viharissāmāti dīpeti pakatiyā vivekajjhāsayabhāvato viraddho āgatassa bhārassa avahanatoyeva.
Pañcasatā hi bhikkhū abhinavā, tasmā tesaṃ ovādadānatthaṃ bhagavā imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhīti.
Kodhupāyāsassāti ettha kujjhanaṭṭhena kodho, sveva cittassa kāyassa ca atippamaddanamathanuppādanehi daḷhaṃ āyāsaṭṭhena upāyāso.
Anekavāraṃ pavattitvā attanā samavetaṃ sattaṃ ajjhottharitvā sīsaṃ ukkhipituṃ adatvā anayabyasanapāpanena kodhupāyāsassa ūmisadisatā daṭṭhabbā.
